finding: A new workflow_dispatch-only workflow cannot provide an executable feature-only path when absent from the default branch.

sources.supports: Manual dispatch requires workflow on default branch.
workflow_dispatch only receives events when workflow file is on default branch.

decision: Use exact feature-branch push with explicit trusted per-target enrollment/enable settings; default disabled. Keep manual trigger only with its documented limitation.
constraints: No main/default branch changes or workflow transfer.
No untrusted pull-request execution on privileged/native runners.
No automatic cancellation of engine-owning checks.
Do not derive expected enrollment from arbitrary observed engine.
No repo settings mutation, dispatch, installation or native execution performed by this review.
currentImplementationOwner: External authorized task, native_compose.py and platform-compose.yml only
